root_cause.text: `ccs_mode_store()` calls `xe_gt_reset()` without first acquiring an outer runtime PM reference, violating the requirement of `xe_pm_runtime_get_noresume()`—which is invoked inside `xe_gt_reset()`—to have a pre-existing runtime PM reference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that `xe_gt_reset()` internally calls `xe_pm_runtime_get_noresume()`, which requires the caller to already hold an outer runtime PM reference and warns if none is held, producing the "Missing outer runtime PM protection" warning. The fix adds `guard(xe_pm_runtime)(xe)` before `xe_gt_reset()` to ensure the reference is held.
